review_comment: The use of `PropertyMapper` adds a lot of noise to what this PR actually changes. I'd prefer if we did that separately (if at all).

If we leave [the associated code](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/pull/23045/commits/006f58d11e480c5739fa3e0ef229a5f88aea3f57#diff-0639742143d9b9f5e21afa9c54628892L73) as-is, then nulls will override what was specified through the metadata endpoint.

Would surrounding each of those lines with if statements be preferrable?
Sorry I missed that. PropertyMapper it is then!
